title: How to: Dance a Basic Step in Progressive Double Two Step

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher presents structured instructional content combining verbal explanation, slide graphics, and solo demonstrations. She breaks down footwork and frame systematically before showing full partner dancing.

lesson_structure.note: Teacher introduces herself and the topic of basic step in Progressive Double Two Step
Overview of history and structure of Progressive Double Two Step
Detailed footwork breakdown for follow from front and side angles
Detailed footwork breakdown for lead from front and side angles
Explanation of upper body frame with a partner demonstration
Demonstration of the basic step together with a partner
Closing remarks and encouragement to practice

metaphors: cup of the leader's extended left hand

steps_taught.name: Follow Footwork
steps_taught.description: Side together side, back it up, walk walk

steps_taught.name: Lead Footwork
steps_taught.description: Left together left, right together right, walk walk

what_hinders: Lack of slow tempo progression during demonstration

quotes.text: Progressive Double Two Step, or Progressive for short, is one of the most popular partner dances.
This means that couples will travel in a counterclockwise direction around the dance floor.
Essential to any partner dance is what is known as frame.

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher speaks directly to the camera introducing the lesson
Dancer demonstrates follow footwork moving sideways and backwards on a wood floor

extraction.distinctive_method: Extensive use of on-screen text graphics and diagrams to explain floor geometry and foot placement before physical demonstration.
